ruleDefinitions.name: DNS Query Tor .Onion Address - Sysmon
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DNS queries to an ".onion" address related to Tor routing networks Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

sequences.query: (QueryName = RGX("\\\.hiddenservice\\\.net$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.ca$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.cab$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.casa$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.city$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.direct$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.dog$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.glass$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.gq$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.ink$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.it$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.link$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.lt$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.lu$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.nu$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.pet$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.plus$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.rip$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.sh$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.to$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion\\\.top$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.onion$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.s1\\\.tor\\-gateways\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.s2\\\.tor\\-gateways\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.s3\\\.tor\\-gateways\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.s4\\\.tor\\-gateways\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.s5\\\.tor\\-gateways\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.t2w\\\.pw$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.ae\\\.org$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.blutmagie\\\.de$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.com$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.fi$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.io$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.org$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.tor2web\\\.xyz$") OR QueryName = RGX("\\\.torlink\\\.co$"))
